auditReports.details: Task 7, 8, and 9 audit reports are valid JSON, but they contain unresolved blocking findings: CA-001, SA-001, TA-001, TA-002.

artifactCheck.details: `git status --short`, `git diff --check`, and repository scan found no staged/generated audio files, SQLite databases, credentials, or secrets.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Voice messages up to 10 minutes are accepted only inside active draft flows where report or insight input is allowed.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_voice_processing_service.py covers weekly and insight active draft routing; no-active-draft path does not download.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Voice messages longer than 10 minutes are rejected with approved Russian copy, are not saved, and are not added to drafts.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_voice_processing_boundaries.py::test_over_limit_voice_has_no_side_effects and tests/test_voice_processing_service.py over-limit coverage.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Accepted audio is stored only under the non-public local audio path and unsafe/public paths are rejected.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: StoragePathPolicy.audio_path is used by VoiceMessageService; tests/test_storage_paths.py rejects public URLs, absolute paths, traversal, and nested fragments.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Successful transcription adds an ordered voice_transcription draft message.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_weekly_report_draft_repository.py, tests/test_insight_draft_repository.py, and tests/test_voice_processing_boundaries.py cover ordered mixed draft messages.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Weekly report final save writes report_text, transcription_text, audio_file_path and preserves status/deadline/step/duplicate guards.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_weekly_report_finalize.py, tests/test_weekly_report_boundaries.py, and full suite regression.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Insight final save writes insight_text, transcription_text, audio_file_path and does not affect weekly progress.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_insight_add_flow.py::test_voice_insight_final_save_includes_transcription_and_audio_path and tests/test_insight_boundaries.py.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Multiple text and voice messages produce final text in the original order.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Final Sheets rows preserve order, but CA-001 shows saved mixed voice insights are displayed through list/full-text paths using transcription_text before insight_text, hiding typed text around the voice fragment.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Download, save, or transcription failures return clear retry/text fallback copy.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_voice_processing_service.py and tests/test_voice_processing_boundaries.py assert VOICE_PROCESSING_FAILED_TEXT.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Technical voice-processing errors go only to the admin error chat.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_voice_processing_boundaries.py::test_voice_failure_routes_only_to_admin_error_chat.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Voice-processing failures do not clear the existing draft and do not create a final Google Sheets fact.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_voice_processing_service.py failure coverage preserves draft text and does not finalize.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Original audio is not logged, committed, or exposed by public link.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: No public URL path accepted; admin errors omit audio path and transcription; repository scan found no generated audio artifacts.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: After future retention deletion, the system continues using transcription_text and does not require the audio file to exist.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Final weekly and insight rows store transcription_text and audio_deleted_at compatibility fields; cleanup scheduler is explicitly outside this implementation slice.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No web form, Docker, Redis, Celery, PostgreSQL, public audio URLs, separate audio archive, or coaching recommendations are added.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Boundary tests and dependency review found no out-of-scope runtime dependency or UI surface.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: user-spec.md is approved before implementation tasks start.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: work/voice-processing/user-spec.md front matter has status: approved.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No live Telegram, Google, OpenAI/Whisper, or external transcription SDK is imported by boundary modules.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_boundaries.py and audit reports verify fake/local boundaries only.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Voice duration over 600 seconds is rejected before download/transcription/draft mutation.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_voice_processing_boundaries.py::test_over_limit_voice_has_no_side_effects.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Accepted voice creates a local non-public audio path through StoragePathPolicy.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/services/voice_messages.py builds audio paths through StoragePathPolicy.audio_path; tests/test_storage_paths.py covers unsafe fragments.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Accepted voice appends one technical attachment row and one ordered voice_transcription draft message.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_weekly_report_draft_repository.py and tests/test_insight_draft_repository.py.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Mixed text and voice messages are assembled in original order for weekly reports and insights.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Final row assembly is covered, but CA-001/TA-001 show saved mixed voice insights are not displayed with the full mixed text through participant-facing list/full-text paths.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Weekly report finalization includes transcription/audio fields and still enforces deadline, duplicate, selected-step, and empty-content guards.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_weekly_report_finalize.py and tests/test_weekly_report_boundaries.py.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Insight finalization includes transcription/audio fields, does not affect weekly status/progress, and preserves post-save draft text cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_insight_add_flow.py, tests/test_insight_boundaries.py, and tests/test_insight_draft_repository.py.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Voice-processing failures preserve active draft and route technical details only to admin error chat.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Draft preservation and admin routing pass, but SA-001 shows failures after successful download can leave untracked local audio without failed attachment metadata or deletion.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Full local pytest suite passes.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` -> 184 passed.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No generated audio files, SQLite databases, credentials, or secrets are staged.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: `git status --short` returned clean before QA edits; artifact scan found no matching files.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Code, security, and test audit reports are valid JSON.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: json.tool passed for task-7/code-audit.json, task-8/security-audit.json, and task-9/test-audit.json.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Audit reports from Tasks 7-9 have no unresolved blocking findings.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: CA-001, SA-001, TA-001, and TA-002 remain unresolved and blocking.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No deploy or live environment action is performed.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Only local pytest, json.tool, git status, git diff --check, rg, and find were used.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No live Telegram, live Google Sheets, real transcription provider, generated audio, or secrets are required for verification.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: All tests use fake/local boundaries and temporary SQLite.

findings.title: Pre-deploy gate is blocked by unresolved blocking audit findings
findings.expected: Tasks 7-9 audit reports have zero unresolved blocking findings before release readiness.
findings.actual: CA-001, SA-001, TA-001, and TA-002 remain unresolved.
findings.reproduction: Run json.tool on the three audit reports and inspect summary.blocking_findings_count plus findings where blocking is true.

findings.title: Saved mixed voice insights can display only voice transcription
findings.expected: Saved insight list/full-text views show the full mixed insight_text in original order.
findings.actual: app/services/insights.py::_insight_item_from_row prefers transcription_text before insight_text, so typed text around a voice fragment can be hidden.
findings.reproduction: Save an insight with text + voice + text, then call list_insights or get_full_text. Expected full mixed text; actual voice-only transcription.

findings.title: Downloaded audio can remain untracked after transcription or append failure
findings.expected: After a post-download failure, the saved local audio is either deleted or tracked in draft_attachments with transcription_status='failed'.
findings.actual: VoiceMessageService catches the failure and notifies admin, but does not delete the downloaded file or persist failed attachment metadata.
findings.reproduction: Force SpeechTranscriber.transcribe to raise after FakeTelegramFileDownloader writes the local file. The response is correct, but the local file is not represented in draft_attachments.

commands.result: pass: no generated audio, SQLite databases, credentials, or secrets found
